THE WAR WITH US STARTS

#OnThisDay in 1899, the Philippine-American war began.

According to sources, the conflict started when William Walter Grayson, a US soldier in present-day Sampaloc, Manila at the time, ordered a group of Filipino soldiers to halt.

However, the latter allegedly did not obey, prompting Grayson to shoot and the Filipinos to return fire.
